_comment: Release manifest. Every Hub with update checks on fetches this file and compares its own version against `version`. Bump it as part of cutting a release, not before - the harness pins it equal to package.json so a manifest that lies about the current release cannot ship.
notes: 2.40.0: print requests from 3MF Explorer (Mark for print there, the Hub queues one print when its gcode is saved), Link gcode by hand, Open in Orca links the right file, timelapses saved to a folder you pick (off until you turn them on in Settings) that no longer freeze on one old picture six minutes into a print, Dispatch refuses to queue the same file twice (raise the count instead), and 3MF Explorer now ships alongside the Hub. 2.39.0: fixes 2.34's timelapse capture losing most of a print. The Hub restarts several times a day for unrelated reasons, and until now a restart mid-print always started a brand-new, empty capture for that printer - every frame from before the restart was silently abandoned on disk. Most timelapses were only ever showing the last few minutes of a print, which is why a print that ran for hours could turn into a video where nothing visibly changes. The Hub now saves its place after every captured frame and a restart resumes the SAME capture where it left off, so frames accumulate across restarts instead of resetting. 2.38.0: Convert to U1 on the Models tab (issue #5) - a MakerWorld or Bambu project becomes a U1 copy that keeps the designer's prime tower, walls, infill and supports. 2.37.0: a Logbook for every printer - what went wrong, what fixed it, and a maintenance schedule by print hours or days. Pauses and errors the printer reports, and printers you take out of service, are logged by themselves; what's due shows on the printer card and can ping your phone. 2.36.0: the planner stops leaving printers idle - no more waiting until midnight for a job to 'fit', and running prints no longer draw twice on the timeline. Models: format folders like U1 and prusa-format are no longer treated as designers, Random shows every model before repeating one and mixes designers, and Rename/Attributes/Delete moved behind a corner menu. Fixed: pressing Open in Orca could freeze the whole Hub for up to half an hour on a network share. 2.35.0: fixes the freeze reported in issue #4 - with several cameras streaming, the page could stop updating after a few minutes; a tile now asks for one frame at a time and the Hub grabs a printer's frame once for everyone waiting. On screens 1500px and wider the dashboard, Dispatch, Models and Match views use the room, so four U1s fit in one row on a 4K monitor. Older releases: see docs/CHANGELOG.md.
